layers.1: Immutable original results at fixed commits
layers.2: study_index.csv: metadata and original row selectors, not scientific result table
layers.3: claim_usage.csv/paper_data_index.csv/comparability.csv: access and usage views,not new adoption

missing_values.unknown: Not recorded/acquired in the bounded source;never impute0
missing_values.not_applicable: Field does not apply to this metadata/technical record
missing_values.not_verified: Declaration or pointer exists but this index did not establish it

field_scope: Family profile describes a family,not exact same condition for every member. Original row/input/candidate controls specific scope. Descriptive strings are not numeric observations.
counts: 49 existing catalogue entries plus9 current access views are NOT58 independent experiments;cross-host aliases and repeated source rows never add n.

metrics.n: Classical PR trajectory cost samples;paired cos/sin are one sample
metrics.N: Sufficient analytic quantum measurement shots;not physical shot execution here
metrics.C: Per-axis compiled RZ instructions unless explicitly theory/model/depth/CX
metrics.G: Original saved sum_a N_a C_a;no new arithmetic here
metrics.SE: Original paired cost-sample SE,not shot SE or rigorous uncertainty

reference_resolution: source_reference uses source_catalog.json.sources key;split at # for selector. three/references.csv#ref_id resolves in fixed upstream catalog. commit:path#/pointer directly resolves a fixed original manifest row.
roles: Catalogue custody is not original execution host;REPRODUCED can mean preregistered PF-cheaper direction. TEST_PASS is not scientific superiority.
adoption: Original CEM v3/ledger v5/paper manifest are authoritative;these views cannot edit or supersede them.
